sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND platform:"Unix"
AND
(
  (process_name:"usermod" AND (process_command_line:" -aG " OR process_command_line:" -G "))
  OR
  (process_name:"gpasswd" AND (process_command_line:" -a " OR process_command_line:" -M "))
  OR
  (process_name:"adduser" AND process_command_line:" sudo")
  OR
  (process_name:"adduser" AND process_command_line:" wheel")
)
AND NOT parent_process_name:("puppet","chef","ansible","salt","cloud-init")
